speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (CJD). The combination of rapidly progressive dementia (confusion with limited orientation), bulbar symptoms (dysphagia), and involuntary movements (myoclonus) is the classic clinical triad for prion disease, which was not addressed by the normal thyroid, ANA, or CSF results.
